preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
The length of the string s for each test case must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '+-' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must consist only of the characters '+' and '-'.
The total length of all strings s across all test cases must not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the count of non-empty promising substrings of the string s.
